tokens.name: midnight-ink
tokens.usage: Primary. Wordmark, towers, headlines, dark bands, footer. Ink on Sand 14.6:1.

tokens.name: launch-amber
tokens.usage: Accent: the tallest tower and the spark, buttons (with Ink text, 5.6:1), highlights. Never small body copy (3.0:1 on white).

tokens.name: amber-deep
tokens.usage: Derived from Launch Amber for small links and labels on white and sand (5.6:1 and 4.9:1). Not in the guidelines: added so small text passes WCAG AA.

tokens.name: amber-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of an amber button (Ink text holds 6.9:1).

tokens.name: desert-sand
tokens.usage: Primary light background; reversed logo colour.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Subline, captions, secondary text on light (5.9:1 on white).

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Subline and secondary text on Ink (7.9:1).

display.use: Headlines SemiBold 600; ExtraBold 800 for the wordmark and hero lines; -2% tracking

logo.rule: Keep x (one tower width) clear on every side. Never stretch, rotate, recolour, add effects, put full colour on Amber, or rearrange.
